{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2009}}
{{main|2009 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2009 World Table Tennis Championships women's singles''' was the 50th edition of the women's singles championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Table Tennis}}</ref> [[Zhang Yining]] won the title, defeating [[Guo Yue (table tennis)|Guo Yue]] by four sets to two.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Past World Championships Results |url=https://www.ittf.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/WorldChWSingles3.pdf |access-date=2026-04-26 |website=International Table Tennis Federation}}</ref> The tournament was dominated by [[China|Chinese]] players, with all four semifinalists from that country and two more Chinese players knocked out by their countrywomen.
